items.title: Deloitte helped in falsifying documents to evade tax on Abramovich’s wealth, BBC finds
items.summary: Backdated paperwork also made the Russian oligarch’s yachts and mansions disappear from accounts, investigation finds.

items.title: Rejecting closer EU ties would be dereliction of duty, PM to say
items.summary: Addressing the Commons, Burnham is expected to say that a new deal with the EU could help tackle illegal immigration and boost economic growth.

items.title: One killed, 11 injured in second Houthi strike on Riyadh airport in two days
items.summary: The Saudi capital has been hit by multiple attacks from the Iran-backed Yemeni group over the weekend.

items.title: Healey faces £35bn Budget challenge to meet spending pledges, says think tank
items.summary: The Institute for Fiscal Studies says the government will need a "top-up" of billions of pounds if it wants to meet its spending plans.

items.title: Reform would suspend asylum system for parliamentary term if in government
items.summary: All asylum applications would be rejected and existing ones voided, with all claimants marked for deportation.

items.title: Watch moment orangutan family released back into the wild after Borneo fires
items.summary: The critically endangered apes were rescued from intense wildfires that destroyed their habitat in August and September.

items.title: PM says it is 'clear' Russia interfered with Brexit vote
items.summary: He says voters were not "sufficiently" informed about how foreign actors sought to disrupt UK democracy.

items.title: Wildlife park remains closed after fatal tiger attack
items.summary: Yorkshire Wildlife Park remains closed after a man entered the tiger enclosure and was fatally attacked on Saturday.
